title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.21940v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for large language model (LLM) agents to maintain consistency and personalization over extended interactions. Existing memory systems typically rely on fixed granularities or static schemas, but these designs struggle when heterogeneous information, such as preferences, events, constraints, and temporal updates, is embedded in a single mixed representation. The resulting semantic interference makes top-K retrieval sensitive to noise and often leaves relevant evidence poorly ranked. We present AutoViewMem, a data-driven framework that organizes long-term conversational memory into self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views before indexing. AutoViewMem discovers candidate views from interaction traces, selects a compact complementary view set, and uses these views to guide write-time structured extraction of provenance-grounded memories. translated_title: AutoViewMem：面向对话长期记忆的自配置正交视图
translated_abstract: 长期记忆对于大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长时间交互中保持一致性和个性化至关重要。现有记忆系统通常依赖固定粒度或静态模式，但当偏好、事件、约束和时间更新等异构信息被嵌入到单一混合表示中时，这些设计会面临困难。由此产生的语义干扰使得top-K检索对噪声敏感，并常常导致相关证据排序不佳。我们提出了AutoViewMem，这是一个数据驱动的框架，它在索引之前将长期对话记忆组织成自配置、低重叠的语义视图。AutoViewMem从交互轨迹中发现候选视图，选择一个紧凑的互补视图集合，并利用这些视图在写入时指导基于来源溯源的结构化记忆提取。这种表示优先的设计将语义解耦从……
tldr: AutoViewMem提出了一种数据驱动的框架，通过在索引前将长期对话记忆组织成自配置、低重叠的语义视图，解决了异构信息混合表示带来的语义干扰问题，从而提升检索的准确性和排序质量。
en_tdlr: AutoViewMem is a data-driven framework that organizes long-term conversational memory into self-configuring, low-overlap semantic views before indexing, mitigating semantic interference from heterogeneous information and improving retrieval accuracy and ranking quality.
